bill.title: Torts: liability; liability for artificial intelligence misidentification; establish. Amends 1961 PA 236 (MCL 600.101 - 600.9947) by adding sec. 2980.

posted_text:
🧠 MI HB 6392 — AI Misidentification Could Cost Police Big Time in Michigan

Michigan could hold AI detection tool providers liable for personal injury, death, or property damage if their tools misidentify someone or a vehicle, and that misidentification leads to law enforcement action. The bill establishes that if an AI tool causes harm, the provider is strictly liable – meaning they’re responsible – unless the harm was reasonably foreseeable. ...
